title: Trump Says Russia, Ukraine Agree To Halt Strikes On Energy Targets

title: Tusk Says Poland On High Alert After Russian Strikes Near Ukraine's Western Border

title: Amid War In Ukraine, Hasidic Jews Gather 'To Pray And Dance' For New Year's Holiday

During the holiday, pilgrims from Israel and around the world travel to the city, a central site for one branch of Orthodox Judaism.
